description.narrative: Commercial bank provided a BRL 50mln 10 year faciity to finance a range of sustainability linked investments that support long term sustainability o fthe company's agricultural operation. AGRI3 has has supported the investment with 40% maturity subordination participation but also with an engagement through an ESAP and potential TA to confirm and enhance the sustainability of the company's operations. The company is a leading producer of oranges (~80% of turnover) with also operations in livestock (full cycle rearing and slaughterhouse) and some minor production of grains and coconuts (production and industrialization of coconut water). The company owns approximately 18,000 hectares (market value of ~BRL 1.3Bn) spread across 9 farms between the states of São Paulo and Minas Gerais and currently has 1,589 employees. The company is considered a front runner on sustainability as reflected in good agricultural practices and certifications (including Sustainable Agriculture Initiative (SAI) Farm Sustainability Assessment (FSA) Gold standard certification) and has shown a strong interest to position itself as a recognizably sustainable and green company in the market.
